tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures indicate a thermal-fin bridge and flux conservation, but the recalled bridge note points to an unresolved downstream mechanism. A discriminating probe is warranted before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the recalled quartic radiation or Newton cooling law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five observations vary only u_now, so they do not identify the bridge mechanism or its dependence on other inputs.
The open-branch probe directly addresses the mechanism ambiguity at lower cost.
It is not relevant to distinguishing the candidate mechanisms.
